outlets.label_note: Online since founding in 2009; bought by Camenzind in 2019. Also covers wider Latin America. Ownership based on Wikipedia only.

outlets.name: Latin America Reports
outlets.label_note: Site footer credits Espacio Media Incubator, a Medellin-based digital media company (also behind Colombia/Argentina/Peru Reports). No source found placing it in Bogota.

outlets.name: Tico Times
outlets.label_note: Founded 1956 as a print weekly; print ended 2012, now online daily with occasional print specials. New owner since late 2017; Wikipedia names Producciones Magnolia but gives no date.

media_types.rule: format is print (began as, or still is, a printed paper or magazine)
ownership is nonprofit, reader-funded or independent (wire services excluded)
scope is local or regional (a city or a state)
covers a specific subject (see the outlet's label)

label_note: Labels are checkable facts: scope, ownership, owner, format, specialist subject and location. Each has a source URL in label_sources. Labels were researched with AI assistance and are marked unverified until a person checks the source and fills in label_review.verified_by and verified_on. There are no political-lean or reliability ratings.
